about_the_game:
This is a role-playing tower defense (RP TD) game.

It is similar to defense-style maps from Warcraft III.

The game features 36 waves of enemies, drawing inspiration from the gameplay of the popular Zhu Xiandefense map and the story setting of the Zhu Xiannovel.

  • Choose from 7 unique heroes at the start: Yun Tian, Qing Xuan, Xiao Fan, Shi Tou, Lu Xueqi, Jing Yu, and Fa Xiang, each with their own distinctive skills.

  • Select from multiple difficulty levels: Easy, Medium, Hard, and Extreme.

  • A Newbie Quest system helps players get started by providing initial equipment and experience.

  • Explore 15 distinct Secret Realms (dungeons), such as Flame Dragon Valley, Ten-Millennium Spider Cave, and Illusory Moon Cave, each offering specific equipment rewards.

  • Purchase weapons, armor, and accessories from various in-game shops.

  • Utilize the Bagua Stone upgrade system, craft Immortal Artifacts from fragments, and assign stat points freely.

  • Powerful Immortal Artifacts include items like the Wuwei Stone, Four Symbols Ring, Zhanhao Divine Wings, Illusory Feather Wings, and Sky Jade Mirror.

  • Legendary equipment, such as the Kirin Gauntlets, Demon-Subduing Sword, and Divine Moon Chord, can be enhanced through combat (attacking/being attacked) or by using Refinement Stones.

  • Use the Bloodforge system to fuse a +5 enhanced Legendary item with an Immortal Artifact.

  • Characters can undergo Rebirth to retain their stats and can join the Bloodforge Hall for advanced equipment refinement.
